extractionMethod.note: Read directly, single-page tables, both Rack and Net Operator documents cross-checked and found structurally identical (same rooms/seasons/supplements, only base figures differ).

structuralFindings: Base meal plan is HALF BOARD (breakfast + dinner + afternoon tea) for BOTH non-resident tariffs — a different base than Baobab/Diamonds (All Inclusive) and closer to Soroi Blue's Half Board base, though Pinewood's supplement structure is simpler.

6 room categories: Deluxe Garden Room (24 units), Premium Garden Room (12), Deluxe Garden Suite (12), Premium Garden Suite (6), Luxury Ocean Front Room (4), Grand Ocean Front Suite (2) — unit counts are stated inventory sizes, useful for availability context.
5 seasonal columns in the 2026 table (given the Nov-Jan gap noted above): 07Jan-28Feb, 01Mar-31Mar, 01Apr-30Jun, 01Jul-30Sep, 01Oct-31Oct.
Hotel closure for renovations: 01 May - 31 May 2026 — no bookings possible in this window regardless of rate.

Full Board supplement +$20 pp/pd; All Inclusive supplement +$44 pp/pd (added cumulatively — AI = HB + both supplements, or possibly AI supplement replaces both; document lists them as two separate line items without clarifying whether AI supplement is inclusive of the FB step — flagged as [Unverified] interpretation).

3rd bed (adult): 30% reduction off adult rate. Children 2-11 sharing room: 50% of adult rate. Children 2-11 in own room: 80% of adult rate (much higher than Soroi's 50% own-room-adjacent policy or Baobab's 75%).
Single supplement: 50% of rate (i.e. single = 1.5x per-person-sharing rate, standard convention).
Easter Supplement $24 pp/pd for specific Fri-Mon dates (03-06 April 2026). Xmas 25th & New Year's Eve 31st Dec: $40 pp/pd. Minimum stay 5 nights for the 24 Dec - 02 Jan period.
Honeymooners: door archway + sparkling wine (all bookings); 7+ night stay gets 30-min his & her massage.
Cancellation policy: 0-14 days prior = 100% chargeable; 15-35 days prior = 50% chargeable (note: no explicit 35+ days band stated, implying no charge beyond 35 days, not confirmed explicitly).
